transactions.desc: The Nationals optioned Varland to Triple-A Rochester following Tuesday's game against the Blue Jays.
Hernandez (oblique) was activated from the 10-day injured list Tuesday, Kirsten Watson of Spectrum SportsNet LA reports.
The Dodgers optioned Freeland to Triple-A Oklahoma City on Tuesday, Katie Woo of The Athletic reports.
The Giants selected Basabe's contract from Triple-A Sacramento on Tuesday.
The Cardinals optioned Dobbins to Triple-A Memphis on Tuesday.
The Cardinals selected Strzelecki's contract from Triple-A Memphis on Tuesday.
The Red Sox recalled Sogard from Triple-A Worcester on Tuesday, Ari Alexander of 7 News Boston reports.
Shewmake rejected an outright assignment to Triple-A Nashville and elected free agency Tuesday, Todd Rosiak of the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel reports.
The Mariners designated Kennedy for assignment Tuesday.
The Mariners reinstated Refsnyder (knee) from the 10-day injured list Tuesday.
The Guardians recalled Espino from Triple-A Columbus on Tuesday, Tim Stebbins of MLB.com reports.
The Royals recalled McGee from Triple-A Omaha on Tuesday.
Atlanta re-signed Hernandez to a one-year contract Tuesday.
Atlanta optioned Thomas to Triple-A Gwinnett on Tuesday.
The Phillies optioned Henry to Triple-A Lehigh Valley on Tuesday, Todd Zolecki of MLB.com reports.
The Phillies activated Stubbs (wrist) from the 10-day injured list Tuesday, Todd Zolecki of MLB.com reports.
The Tigers designated Rogers for assignment Tuesday, Evan Woodbery of MLive.com reports.
The Tigers activated Baez (ankle) from the 60-day injured list, and he's starting in center field and batting ninth Tuesday against the Orioles.
The Twins recalled Anderson from Triple-A St. Paul on Tuesday.
The Nationals recalled Varland from Triple-A Rochester on Tuesday, Grant Paulsen of 106.7 The Fan reports.
The Reds recalled Franco from Triple-A Louisville on Tuesday, Charlie Goldsmith of Fox 19 Now Cincinnati reports.
Hernandez was sent outright to Triple-A Gwinnett on Monday.

The Nationals optioned Alvarez to Triple-A Rochester following Monday's 3-2 loss to Toronto. He allowed one earned run on four hits and three walks while striking out three across 4.1 innings in bulk relief.
The Baltimore Orioles traded OF Johnathan Rodríguez to the Pittsburgh Pirates.
The Pirates designated Ross for assignment Monday.
The Tigers recalled Valencia from Triple-A Toledo on Monday.
The Cubs selected Wantz's contract from Triple-A Iowa on Monday.
The Cubs designated Taillon for assignment Monday.
The Blue Jays reinstated Scherzer (back/thumb) from the 15-day injured list ahead of his scheduled start Monday in Washington.
The Pirates optioned Ross to Triple-A Indianapolis on Monday, Danny Demilio of PittsburghBaseballNow.com reports.
